mapper.select: SELECT run_id AS "runId", count(*) AS "eventCount" FROM wb_event WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY run_id
SELECT count(*) AS run_count, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, coalesce(round(avg(duration_ms)), 0) AS avg_duration_ms FROM wb_run

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, count(*) AS run_count, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, round(coalesce(avg(CASE WHEN state = 'success' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS success_rate FROM wb_run
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', created_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('day', created_at) ASC

SELECT coalesce(model_name, '') AS model_name, count(*) AS run_count, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens FROM wb_run
GROUP BY coalesce(model_name, '') ORDER BY coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) + coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) DESC

SELECT state AS state, count(*) AS run_count FROM wb_run
GROUP BY state ORDER BY count(*) DESC
